name: kontra-workspace
description: pnpm workspace root. The publishable package here is shared/core (@kontra/core); control/orchestrator is never published.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @kontra/core run build && pnpm --filter @kontra/backend run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @kontra/core run build && pnpm --filter @kontra/backend run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @kontra/core run build && pnpm --filter @kontra/backend run test
